m1.typescript: m1 every situation of the bank gets its mechanism and its reason

e1.typescript: e1 a rule that must hold goes to a hook whatever else is true

e2.typescript: e2 an outside system needs a server and noisy work alone needs a subagent

e3.typescript: e3 knowledge goes to the file or skill that loads it at the right time

e4.typescript: e4 a plugin carries a skill hook subagent or server to a second repository and nothing else

e5.typescript: e5 in an application the platform may supply the schema and only a remote server replaces your own tool

e6.typescript: e6 an unknown value is an error and a missing key takes its default

e7.typescript: e7 a pipeline a condition a long command and an event are not intervals

e8.typescript: e8 an interval is a loop in the session and a routine or desktop task when it must outlive it

e9.typescript: e9 a personal preference goes to a style a status line or a key binding and knowledge keeps its own rules

wrong-guarantee-yields-to-timing.defect: lets a schedule or an event decide before a rule that must hold every time

wrong-guarantee-yields-to-scope.defect: does not make a hook of a rule that comes with a path-scoped convention

wrong-server-yields-to-timing.defect: lets a schedule or an event decide before an outside system that needs a server

wrong-noisy-yields-to-pipeline.defect: lets a pipeline or an away run decide before noisy work that needs its own context

wrong-scope-without-convention.defect: sends a path scope with no convention to the path rules

wrong-reference-follows-scope.defect: drops reference material when it is also path scoped

wrong-hook-not-carried.defect: leaves a hook out of what a plugin carries

wrong-path-rule-carried.defect: packages a path rule as a plugin, which cannot carry one

wrong-server-beats-builtin.defect: prefers a remote server to the schema the platform supplies

wrong-server-without-remote.defect: uses the connector in an application when no outside system needs it or no remote server exists

wrong-no-validation.defect: accepts a knowledge kind it does not know

wrong-no-timing-validation.defect: accepts a timing it does not know

wrong-away-sees-local-files.defect: lets a run with the computer off read local files

wrong-pipeline-needs-no-timing.defect: treats a pipeline job that also has an interval as a loop

wrong-condition-needs-session.defect: does not make a goal of a condition when nobody is at the session

wrong-event-always-monitor.defect: watches an event in the session even when the computer is off

wrong-expiry-inclusive.defect: moves a job of exactly seven days off the loop that still holds it

wrong-desktop-without-local-files.defect: makes a desktop task of every long interval job, local files or not

wrong-knowledge-beats-personal.defect: answers a personal preference with the knowledge file when one is also given

wrong-personal-beats-timing.defect: answers a personal preference before a timed job
